changes.title: Stabbings near New York City’s Central Park
changes.summary: Terrifying moments in New York City this afternoon when two people were stabbed near Central Park, just feet from a synagogue. Witnesses say the attacker yelled Allahu-Akbar. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin has the latest on the investigation.

changes.title: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul explains why she signed the first statewide moratorium on data centers
changes.summary: Speaking with NBC News’ “Here’s the Scoop,” Hochul said that she’s responding to the concerns of localities and that New York doesn’t need data centers to support the AI boom.

changes.title: Mamdani says he won't try to arrest Israel's Netanyahu
changes.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani conceded late Tuesday that the city does not have the authority to arrest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

changes.title: The latest US troops killed in Trump’s Iran war are remembered for lives of service
changes.summary: Angel Rampersad, Michael Swinton, Isabella Gonzales and Tyler Feehan were among 18 US troops killed in the war A 30-year-old husband and father of two. A 25-year-old officer just weeks away from earning his MBA. A 19-year-old recent high school graduate. And a 28-year-old from Queens, New York, with a “radiant smile”.

changes.title: Mamdani Knew He Couldn’t Arrest Netanyahu. But He Could Denounce Him.
changes.summary: In a video message, the mayor of New York City said he could not legally arrest Israel’s prime minister but reinforced his position as a voice of the international left.

changes.title: Mamdani says NYC can't arrest Netanyahu but the federal government should
changes.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani said late Tuesday that the city would not be able to execute an arrest warrant issued by the world's top war-crimes court for Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu, but urged the federal government to do so.

changes.title: Mamdani says New York City can't arrest Netanyahu but the federal government should
changes.summary: New York Mayor Mamdani said the city would not be able to execute an arrest warrant issued by the top war-crimes court for Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu, but urged the federal government to do so. (Image credit: Anna Connors/Anna Connors).

changes.title: Mamdani Calls Netanyahu a ‘War Criminal’ and Calls on U.S. to Arrest Him
changes.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani challenged the United States to execute an international arrest warrant against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel, which New York itself cannot do.

changes.title: New York Mayor Mamdani Admits He Can’t Arrest ‘War Criminal’ Netanyahu
changes.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani speaks in a video posted on X on July 21, 2026. —Screenshot from Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani's X account (@NYCMayor) Since campaigning for New York City mayor, Zohran Mamdani has pledged to arrest Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for his alleged war crimes if he ever shows up.

changes.title: Mamdani says he won't try to arrest Israel's Netanyahu, acknowledges NYC doesn't have legal authority
changes.summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani conceded late Tuesday that the city does not have the authority to arrest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
